title: Yoga Nidra Teacher Training
description: A comprehensive training designed for yoga teachers, therapists, wellbeing practitioners, and anyone wishing to deepen their understanding of Yoga Nidra. Explore the philosophy of Yoga Nidra, the science of relaxation, guided practice techniques, creating and leading sessions, nervous system regulation, and practical teaching skills.
format: Accredited by YogaPros (formerly Yoga Alliance Professional UK)

title: Meditation & Mantra Training
description: Discover the power of meditation and mantra as tools for awareness, concentration, relaxation, and personal transformation. Suitable for teachers and practitioners wishing to deepen their knowledge and practice.
format: For deeper awareness, relaxation and personal growth

title: Soul Sundays (Online)
description: A weekly online yoga and wellbeing class designed to help you begin the week feeling calmer, stronger, and more connected. Includes gentle yoga movement, mobility and stretching, breath awareness, mindfulness, and relaxation. Suitable for all levels.
